task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OIDC-03 at src/design/oidc-03-configuration-source.md. Define how startup configuration selects the active identity provider adapter (environment-variable based until Stage 10), including required fields (provider type, base URL, admin credentials reference, default realm/tenant identifier), validation rules, failure modes, and clear startup error contracts. Specify module boundaries, configuration schema, loader/bootstrap flow, and test seams so adapter selection is provider-agnostic outside adapter packages. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines configuration schema and startup adapter selection flow for OIDC-03
Design covers all required OIDC-03 fields and validation/error behavior
Design maps OIDC-03 acceptance criteria to concrete validation or test points
Design preserves provider-agnostic boundaries outside adapter modules
Design identifies backend touchpoints and implementation/test sequencing for Step 02+

result.summary: Designed OIDC-03 configuration-source architecture at src/design/oidc-03-configuration-source.md, including provider selection schema, startup validation rules, failure/error contracts, module boundaries, bootstrap flow, acceptance-traceable test seams, and Step 02+ implementation sequencing.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for configuration loader/bootstrap implementation, then TEST-DESIGNER for startup validation and provider-selection coverage.
